subject.title: Active Memory with Cerebras gpt-oss-120b times out and can pin gateway CPU

question: Does a current-main live run with `cerebras/gpt-oss-120b` demonstrate that Active Memory timeout cancellation settles all embedded and provider work while the gateway remains responsive?
rationale: Source inspection establishes substantial generic mitigations but cannot prove the provider stream and event loop settle correctly under the reported external model behavior.

options.title: Require live current-main proof
options.body: Run a maintainer-controlled Cerebras reproduction and keep the issue open unless timeout, CPU, event-loop, and health evidence all show clean settlement.

options.title: Accept generic mitigation evidence
options.body: Close only if maintainers intentionally consider the generic lane and cleanup changes sufficient without provider-specific runtime verification.

recommendation.title: Require live current-main proof
recommendation.body: Run a maintainer-controlled Cerebras reproduction and keep the issue open unless timeout, CPU, event-loop, and health evidence all show clean settlement.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent dedicated-lane work is closest to the current timeout execution boundary and likely informs the correct proof scenario.
